The Library is not open to the public and is available only to registered readers. For further details, please visit the Library and Archives pages.

Balliol College welcomes visitors who wish to tour our buildings and gardens. We are open as often as we can be, but from time to time there are College events that require the College to be closed. As part of admission, you will be able to visit the gardens, Chapel and Hall.
We are open from 10 . 00 am until 5 . 00 pm (or dusk, whichever is sooner).
Entry fee: £ 6 per adult, £ 3 concessions and students, free to potential applicants.
Admission includes free map and guide.
Members of Oxford University and Oxford alumni are allowed free entry.
The Meadow is open free of charge throughout the year (except 25 December) offering a peaceful and beautiful space for everyone to enjoy.

Corpus Christi College welcomes visitors daily from 2.00pm – 5.00pm. We welcome groups subject to a maximum of 19 people. Occasionally during the year we will be closed for College events so it is always best to contact the Porters on 01865 276700 prior to planning a visit.
The College Library is closed to visitors as it is a place of quiet study. If you wish to see the Library, you must make an appointment with the Development office .
Bodleian Card holders and Oxford Alumni Card holders can visit for free, daily between 2 pm and 5 pm, provided they have their card with them and the College is not closed for a special event.
Members of the public are welcome to visit outside of term time provided they are with a pre-booked tour group. Entrance costs £4 per person.
We suggest all visitors contact the Porters’ Lodge on 01865 279600 to check the College is open (and any parts that may be closed) before visiting.

If you are a prospective student interested in attending Lincoln College, please do come and have a look round. We are open daily from 2pm to 5pm. If you would like a full tour of the College, please contact the Admissions Office to see if someone is available to show you round (Monday-Friday, 9am to 5pm).

If you are planning to drive into Oxford city centre, please be aware of additional travel restrictions. The High Street is closed to private vehicles between 7.30am and 6.30pm daily. There is also a rising bollard in operation on Turl Street.

The Great Lawn is currently closed to visitors as it has suffered so much this year, largely owing to some highly variable and very challenging weather patterns. As a matter of urgency, it needs to undergo mandatory rest and maintenance work. The Daisy Lawn remains open for your enjoyment.
Chapel The Chapel is open Thursday to Tuesday from 1.30 to 5.00 pm, or until dusk in the winter. The Chapel is closed on Wednesdays.

On 18 September, tours of the College are available all day from 8am to 5pm. We hope you will stop by for free breakfast, tea with our tutors, demonstration interviews, admissions tips and a chat with our student ambassadors.

Walking up from the main train station is very convenient. Several regular bus services run virtually door to door in just under ten minutes, with a return costing around £4. You can walk the same distance in around 15-20 minutes.
